threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You think checking the Tube status app will save you time during a strike. It won’t. You'll learn to live by bus schedules and street signs instead.
Caught the 59 last night; two guys were having a full debate over the best chicken spot in Brixton. Almost missed my stop listening in.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When the kebab vendor remembered my order and joked about the weather. That’s when I knew Neukölln had wrapped itself around me.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find Döner kebab shops doubling as late-night bars, complete with DJs spinning from behind the counter. Now that's multitasking.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know that the taco trucks around 24th and Mission close before it gets dark. Newbies think they can grab a bite late night.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 21 this morning, it stopped for a full five minutes because a man wanted to finish his conversation with the driver. Classic SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think Gràcia is all about Gaudí, but they miss the quiet squares where locals argue about football over a caña.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still asking for directions to places like El Xampanyet, not realizing it’s barely a five-minute walk from Plaça del Sol.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think that buskers in the tube are a joy rather than just another reason to avoid the station during strike chaos.
Caught the 35 last night; two guys were arguing over a half-eaten pizza. Turns out they were friends, just hard to tell in the dim light.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I spotted a group of kids transforming a random sidewalk into an art gallery right before sunset - classic Neukölln magic.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can grab a Döner and listen to live techno music at 3 AM, all while surrounded by graffiti art. It's a vibe that can't be found anywhere else.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a true local by how they navigate the BART delays—it's like a dance, while newcomers just look lost and frustrated.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Watched a guy juggling in the rain while waiting for the 31. Muni pulls up right as he finishes—crowd goes wild. Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is just about Gaudí, but they miss the hidden plazas where locals chat over vermut. That's where the real magic is.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their instinct to stand bewildered at every metro station map, while locals glide past without a glance.
